name: Pavani Kankanala
bio: My name is Pavani Kankanala, and I am serving as your State Historian and Reporter. This is my third year in FBLA and my first year on the State Board, and I'm excited to contribute in a new leadership role. As Historian and Reporter, I look forward to highlighting the achievements of our members, sharing our story, and helping showcase all that FBLA accomplishes throughout the year.
